body:
Adds `research/sparse-outer-sync`, a companion to `noisy-local-sgd` and `partial-participation`.

- Unbiased sparsification of the pseudo-gradient inflates the stationary noise floor by exactly 1/p.
- Error feedback has an exact closed form (4-dim second-moment recursion) and costs only 1+αs(1/p−1) at small steps for any N.
- Its price is speed: the mean dynamics have determinant 1−p, so contraction is at best √(1−p) per round.
- Stability limits, matched-rate floors and horizon losses are tabulated; simulation matches within 1.5%.

12 tests pass; `python site/build.py` prints ok (README bullet and `site/projects.json` entry added).
